decision.root_cause: The Python 3.11-slim image does not include the distutils module (specifically distutils.msvccompiler) required to build numpy from source. numpy==1.19.0 lacks a binary wheel for Python 3.11, so pip attempts a source build which fails due to the missing distutils component.
decision.verification_command: pip install --no-cache-dir --prefer-binary -r requirements.runagain.txt && python -c "import numpy; print('numpy version:', numpy.__version__)"
sources_used: traceback showing ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'distutils.msvccompiler'
knowledge that Debian's python3-distutils package provides the distutils module in slim images

decision.root_cause: The package python3-distutils is not available in Debian trixie (Debian 13) repositories, likely because it was removed or transitioned; the Python 3.11 slim image already includes distutils in the standard library.

FROM python:3.11-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-distutils && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --prefer-binary -r requirements.runagain.txt
